dedupe_keys.name: fame io model input and output package

description: FAME-Io is a Python package for preparing inputs to FAME energy-system models and reading their outputs. The own GitLab repository describes input-file creation, output digestion and metadata annotations; it is a separate package from the FAME-Core model engine already drafted in this G5 review. Spatial coverage and time period depend on the simulation prepared by the user, not on a fixed data collection. The own GitLab licence file states Apache-2.0. A modeller can use it to build repeatable scenario inputs and compare outputs from energy-market or infrastructure planning runs. A caveat is that formatting and annotation cannot verify the physical or economic assumptions in a FAME model. Compatibility also depends on the versions of other FAME components. No matching catalogue or first-review package record was found. The JOSS article, own GitLab metadata, README and licence were read without installing FAME or running a scenario.
